about: Patrick Mizell is a Business Litigation attorney working in Houston, Texas. Patrick Mizell assists clients with Personal Injury - General: Defense issues. Patrick Mizell works as an attorney at Vinson & Elkins L.L.P.
As one of a small number of attorneys selected to Super Lawyers, Patrick Mizell gained this recognition through professional achievement, peer recognition, and other distinguishing criteria.
He graduated from University of Houston Law Center in 1989.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
